title: Inter Folia - Update - 1 million books and a cat
author: alltheprivilege
selftext:
Get free while you can before we go to Steam in a couple months: [https://noodleonit.itch.io/inter-folia](https://noodleonit.itch.io/inter-folia)  
  
Thanks for some great feedback so far! We've listened to the audience and have an important update....  
  
A cat!  
  
Also, there are now 1 million books shelved for browsing across five libraries. 180,000 books are free and readable in-game.  
  
New 'featured books' and 'most popular' book displays make it easy to find some of the best free titles available for reading.

\----------------------------

Some development thoughts. The cat was my first venture into using AI to create an animated creature.. The version you see in video is about 30 iterations in... I knew it would be a challenge so saved up a Claude reset (with pro account) and took a whole weekend to tackle it. The results are honestly better than I expected, but surprised there aren't more free assets online given how easy it would be for someone to create and post these. The only free cat i saw on Fab was downright terrible.
